units.source_text: 这是多么盛大的精灵祭啊。

en.t: What a grand festival of spirits this is.

units.source_text: 今年结的瓜是精灵，茄是精灵，加茂川的水也是精灵，桃、柿，一切果实都是精灵，死者是精灵，生者也是精灵。

en.t: The melons that ripened this year are spirits, the eggplants are spirits, the water of the Kamo River is also a spirit, peaches, persimmons, and every fruit are spirits, the dead are spirits, and the living are spirits too.

units.source_text: 这些精灵都聚拢过来，一心相会，他们只觉得“呀，呀，太难得了”。

en.t: All these spirits gather together and meet in one heart, feeling only, Ah, ah, how rare and precious this is.

units.source_text: 不过，这只是整个精灵祭，即所谓一心法界的说教。

en.t: However, this is only the sermon of the whole festival of spirits, the so called teaching that one mind is the realm of all phenomena.

units.source_text: 法界即一心，一心即法界，草木国土皆成佛祭也。

en.t: The realm of all phenomena is one mind, and one mind is the realm of all phenomena; grasses, trees, lands, and nations all become Buddhas in this festival.
